args.title: Tamarack Components Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights autonomous carts boosting pick rates by 18%, though system integration took twice as long as planned.
- Linked article (blog.tamarack.example): Confirms the 18% pick-rate gain from autonomous carts, with integration timelines running 2x over estimate — a cautionary note on rollout planning.
- Companion piece (insights.tamarack.example): Identifies the biggest financial benefit as a reduction in mis-picks, suggesting error-reduction may be the strongest ROI driver versus raw speed gains.
